caption:
Can someone explain this? 😤

You pay your rent on time for years. Every single month.

And it often never shows up on your credit report, unless it's reported.

So what counts as proof you're responsible?

Does your rent get reported?
first_comment: Does your landlord report rent? Yes, no, or no idea? 👇

instagram.first_comment: Rent reported or not? Drop it below. @creditscoretruths 👇

card.headline: Why doesn't on-time rent count unless it's reported?
card.sub: Most renters' payments never reach the bureaus.
